resolution: The sources read here take being analogically: Aristotle's pros hen (STMT-BEING-SAID-PROS-HEN), Aquinas' analogy of divine names (STMT-DIVINE-NAMES-ANALOGICAL), being as the first analogical predicate (STMT-BEING-FIRST-ANALOGICAL-PREDICATE), and grades of being by approach to God (STMT-BEING-MEASURED-BY-APPROACH-TO-GOD). The quarta via premises that speak of more and less in being (STMT-GRADES-HAVE-A-MAXIMUM, STMT-MOST-TRUE-IS-MOST-BEING, STMT-MAXIMUM-IN-GENUS-CAUSES-ALL-IN-GENUS) are to be read in this analogical sense. Their Lean form does not encode it: `MoreIn esse` is a primitive comparative compatible with both senses. The two senses now have order models (DEF-HOMOGENEOUS-SCALE for the univocal sense, DEF-ORDER-BY-APPROACH-TO-A-PRIMARY for attribution), and DISAMB-ORDER-OF-BEING records, premise by premise, which survive on which model. The source-bound STMT-SYNONYMOUS-CAUSE-OF-QUALITY-IS-AT-LEAST-AS-SUCH requires a shared defining account (DEF-SHARED-DEFINING-ACCOUNT); STMT-CAUSE-OF-QUALITY-IN-ANOTHER-IS-MORE-SUCH drops that condition and remains an unattributed open premise; STMT-SYNONYMOUS-CAUSE-OF-QUALITY-IS-MORE-SUCH retains the condition but adds strict superiority and likewise remains unattributed. Applying either to analogical being needs independent justification; analogy and failure of a shared account are not identified. The attribution-order result STMT-ATTRIBUTION-ORDER-RESTRICTS-CAUSE-MORE-SUCH derives a primary-as-cause comparison under strict primacy and gives a countermodel to unrestricted comparison; it does not establish synonymy or source the unrestricted use with the primary as effect in AQUINAS-ST-I-Q2-A3-FIRST-MOVER-IS-FIRST-BEING.
